verdict.rationale: Gumloop is an AI agent platform that routes user data to third-party models, so a training opt-out or no-training guarantee is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a data-training opt-out, a no-training policy, or zero-retention terms. Bring-your-own-API-keys is a separate feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
